how to become someone people
trust instantly

keeping small promises

if you say you'll text back, text back. if you say five minutes, be there in five. people build their trust in you from tiny promises long before the big ones.

remembering what matters

when someone mentions an exam, a trip or a sick parent, ask about it next time. remembering what matters to people is the fastest way to earn their trust.

knowing your stuff

spend 5 minutes a day learning one solid fact about the world: history, science, art. people trust those who speak calmly about things they actually understand.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing your stuff

i spend 5 minutes a day learning one solid fact about history, science or art. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and people trust you more when you know your stuff.

slides.texte_overlay:
admitting what you don't know

say i don't know when you don't know, then find out. people trust someone who admits their gaps far more than someone who pretends to know everything.

no gossip

never talk badly about someone who isn't in the room. the people listening quietly wonder what you say about them, and staying out of it makes you the safe one.
